function.description: Use this controller-specific SSID/WLAN collection API for list, show, detail, and filter questions about SSIDs or WLANs associated with one wireless controller. For example, "List all WLANs on wireless controller <UUID>" calls this API with that UUID as networkDeviceId. Pass a user-supplied controller UUID directly as networkDeviceId. If a controller hostname, management IP, or serial number is provided instead, resolve the controller first with get_device_details, take the canonical controller UUID from the result, and then continue to this API; never pass the hostname, IP, or serial number as networkDeviceId and do not stop after controller resolution. Controller-detail responses establish identity but do not return the controller-specific SSID/WLAN collection. Do not use api_getSSIDBySite for a controller-scoped request; that API is only for an explicit site-scoped SSID query. Do not use api_getPnP*. For out-of-band SSID/WLAN queries use managed=false. For provisioned or design-managed SSID/WLAN queries use managed=true. When the user asks for all results, page with limit=500 and offset=1, increase offset by 500, and continue until a page returns fewer than 500 records; merge every page before answering.
function.name: api_getSSIDDetailsForSpecificWirelessController

adminStatus.description: Utilize this query parameter to obtain the administrative status. A 'true' value signifies that the admin status of the SSID is enabled, while a 'false' value indicates that the admin status of the SSID is disabled.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to be fetched. If not provided, 500 records will be fetched by default

managed.description: If value is 'true' means SSIDs are configured through design.If the value is 'false' means out of band configuration from the Wireless Controller.

networkDeviceId.description: Required canonical wireless-controller UUID only. Pass a UUID supplied by the user directly. Do not pass a hostname, FQDN, management IP, or serial number in this slot. For those identifiers, first call get_device_details for the Wireless Controller, take the canonical device ID/UUID from its result, and continue to this SSID API with that UUID as networkDeviceId.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

ssidName.description: Exact SSID name only. Remove only the leading standalone query noun SSID or WLAN from the user's phrase while preserving the remaining name exactly: "WLAN TWO" becomes "TWO", and "SSID Employee WiFi" becomes "Employee WiFi". Do not include that syntactic SSID/WLAN noun in this value, but preserve it when it is part of a quoted configured name or part of the name itself.

adminStatus.description: Utilize this query parameter to obtain the administrative status. A 'true' value signifies that the admin status of the SSID is enabled, while a 'false' value indicates that the admin status of the SSID is disabled.

l2Security.description: This represents the identifier for the Layer 2 authentication type. The authentication types supported include wpa2_enterprise, wpa2_personal, open, wpa3_enterprise, wpa3_personal, wpa2_wpa3_personal, wpa2_wpa3_enterprise, and open-secured.

l3Security.description: This represents the identifier for the Layer 3 authentication type. The authentication types supported are 'open' and 'webauth'.

managed.description: If the value is 'true,' the SSID is configured through design; if 'false,' it indicates out-of-band configuration on the Wireless LAN Controller.

radioPolicy.description: This represents the identifier for the radio policy. The policies supported include 2.4GHz, 5GHz, and 6GHz.
